entries.title: Nehemiah 6:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Sanballat practises by craft, by rumours, and by hired prophecies, to terrify Nehemiah. 15 The work is finished, to the terror of the enemies. 17 Secret intelligence passes between the enemies and the nobles of Judah.

when Sanballat. 2:10,19; 4:1,7 Geshem. 6 Gashmu. no breach. 4:6,7; Da 9:25 at that time. 3:1,3,6

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Come.They wished to get him out of Jerusalem, from his friends, that they might either carry him off or murder him.

2Sa 3:27; 20:9; Ps 37:12; Pr 26:24-26; Ec 4:4 Ono. 11:35; 1Ch 8:12 they thought. Ps 12:2; 37:12,32; Jer 41:2; Eze 33:31; Mic 7:4,5; Lu 20:19-21

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: And I sent. Pr 14:15; Mt 10:16 I am doing. Ec 9:10; Lu 14:30; Joh 9:4; 1Ti 4:15,16

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: four times. Jud 16:6,10,15-20; Pr 7:21; Lu 18:5; 1Co 15:58; Ga 2:5 and I answered. Pr 14:15

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
with an open letter.This was a gross insult to a person of Nehemiah's quality; as the letters sent to chiefs and governors in the East are always carefully folded up, put in silk bags, and then sealed.

2Ki 18:26-28; 2Co 2:11; 11:13-15; Eph 6:11; 2Th 2:10

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: It is reported. Jer 9:3-6; 20:10; Mt 5:11; Ro 3:8; 2Co 6:8; 1Pe 2:12,13; 3:16 Gashmu. 1,2 Geshem. that thou and. 2:19; Ezr 4:12,15 that thou mayest. Lu 23:2; Joh 19:13

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Shemaiah. 12; Ezr 8:16; 10:31; Pr 11:9; Mt 7:15 shut up. 2Ki 9:8; Jer 36:5; Eze 3:24 Let us meet. Ps 12:2; 37:12; 120:2,3 the house. 1Ki 6:5; 2Ki 11:3 let us shut. 2Ch 28:24; 29:3,7; Mal 1:10; Ac 21:30 in the night. Job 24:13-17; Joh 3:20

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: when all our enemies. 2:10; 4:1,7; 6:1,2 for they perceived. Ex 14:25; Nu 23:23; Jos 5:1; Ps 126:2; Ac 5:38

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:17
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the nobles. 3:5; 5:7; 13:28; Mic 7:1-6; Mt 24:10-12 sent many letters unto Tobiah. Heb. multiplied their letterspassing to Tobiah.

entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: they reported. Pr 28:4; Joh 7:7; 15:19; 1Jo 4:5 words. or, matters. to put. 9,13; Isa 37:10-14; Ac 4:18-21
